name: Network History (Connected Networks)
os_min: Windows Vista (NetworkList keys); Interfaces/NetworkCards present since Windows XP
purpose: Identifies networks the computer has connected to, including domain/intranet name, SSID, first and last connection times, and the network gateway's MAC address; covers wired, wireless, and VPN connections.
key_fields: Interfaces\{adapter-GUID}\DhcpDomain - correlates an interface to its network domain
NetworkList\Nla\Cache entries - cached network location-awareness data
normal_baseline: A small, stable set of known/expected networks (home, office, approved VPN) with DateLastConnected timestamps consistent with routine use.
anomalies: A Profile/Signature entry for an unfamiliar SSID or gateway MAC appearing around a suspected compromise window
A VPN-type (NameType 0x17) profile the user or organization does not recognize, consistent with attacker-established persistence or a tunnel out of the environment
A gateway MAC address associated with a known public or otherwise unexpected location inconsistent with the user's claimed whereabouts at the time
DateCreated/DateLastConnected values inconsistent with the surrounding activity timeline, suggesting manipulation
anti_forensic_notes: These keys are populated by the OS only at connection time and hold no lower-level backup - deleting a Profile or Signature subkey removes that network's history entirely. A wired-only host still generates a Profiles/Signatures entry for its wired connection, so the absence of any wireless-type entries here is not by itself conclusive that Wi-Fi was never used; corroborate against wifi-profiles and the WLAN event log.
interpretation: These keys correlate with each other: Interfaces links to NetworkCards/Signatures via the DhcpDomain value, while Signatures and Profiles link to each other via the ProfileGUID value, together building a richer picture of network activity including VPN connections. The MAC address of the gateway for an SSID can assist with device geolocation. NetworkList Profile NameType values: 6 (0x06) = Wired, 23 (0x17) = VPN, 71 (0x47) = Wireless, 243 (0xF3) = Mobile Broadband.
